partner_result_applied.result: Diffuse rank-two averaged Fourier L^(3/2) estimate and rank-two-plus-independent-square smoothing.

proved_results: Every one-dimensional quadratic gate with arbitrary density cap has a translation-uniform local L2 frequency-energy bound: length L gives L when |a|L<1 and |a|^-1[8+4*pi(1+log(|a|L))] when |a|L>=1.
The induced local eta-superlevel measure has the corresponding Chebyshev bound.
The logarithmic long-interval growth is sharp in order for the admissible uniform [0,1] law.
Applying account03/B01's rank-two L^(3/2) Fourier estimate to the prior square-gate L3 estimate reproduces the <8.103 diffuse-rank2-plus-independent-square density bound on the frequency side.

For f_R=1_[1,R]/(x log R), the direct absolute ambiguity-factor Hausdorff-Young/Hölder majorant grows logarithmically even for the diagonal three-square form; this refutes that intermediate mechanism but not QFORM.
unresolved_implication: COUPLED-CANCELLATION / PRODUCT-PRESERVING-THIRD-GATE: combine the completed rank-two averaged theorem with a third large spectral direction without post-rotation independence and without the multiscale logarithmic loss from early absolute values.
next_step: Keep the exact squaring identity but preserve oscillatory cancellation in the displacement variables, or derive a product-preserving decomposition yielding the partner rank-two factor and a third quadratic gate before Fourier inversion.
